MTS Acumen™ Electrodynamic Test Systems
Product catalog summary
Overview
MTS Acumen Electrodynamic Test Systems are designed for both dynamic and static testing of materials and components. They are known for their precision, user-friendliness, and energy-efficient electrodynamic actuation, allowing for quick installation with minimal impact on facilities.
Key Features
Accurate: Offers precise load and motion control with a rigid load frame and direct-drive linear motor.
Efficient: Operates with low energy consumption and can be powered by a standard electrical outlet.
Easy to Use: User-friendly design with minimal maintenance requirements.
Applications
Materials Testing: Suitable for testing polymers, composites, and other materials under dynamic and static conditions.
Biomedical Testing: Ideal for testing biomaterials and medical device components, with an optional fluid bath for simulating in-vivo conditions.
Research and Development: Supports a variety of tests with quick setup and changeover.
Start-ups: Enables in-house testing to reduce outsourcing needs.
Technical Specifications
Advanced Electrodynamic Actuation: Features a direct-drive linear motor for high accuracy and repeatability.
High-Stiffness Configuration: Ensures reliable stiffness and alignment to prevent measurement errors.
Force Accuracy: Equipped with industry-leading load cells and integrated acceleration sensors for error compensation.
Durability: Constructed with high-quality materials for long-term durability and resistance to damage.
Design and Usability
Simple Installation: Connects to a standard electrical outlet without requiring additional infrastructure.
Scalable Controllers: A single controller can manage multiple load frames, reducing costs and saving space.
Streamlined Cabling: Features color-coded and bundled cables for quick, error-free attachment.
Quiet Operation: Operates quietly even at maximum capacity.
Safety and Integration
Comprehensive Controls: Includes frame-mounted controls with powered crosshead lifts and an emergency stop for safety.
Integrated Safety Features: Features an actuator brake, redundant velocity monitoring, and optional enclosure for compliance with safety standards.
Software Integration: Utilizes MTS TestSuite Multipurpose Software for test definition, execution, analysis, and reporting.
Test Setup and Flow Creation
The document describes the process of setting up tests using MTS TestSuite Multipurpose software, highlighting the ease of creating test flows with templates or custom arrangements to maximize productivity and minimize errors.
Actuator Control
The software provides a visual representation of the actuator's position, simplifying adjustments. Operators can easily adjust the actuator using up or down buttons without needing to understand value directions.
Iconography and User Interface
The system uses consistent iconography across physical controls and software interfaces, reducing errors and facilitating global adoption by minimizing language dependency.
Data Analysis and Reporting
The software includes robust tools for post-test data interaction, such as movable markers and zoom capabilities, and offers flexible reporting options for sharing test data.
Comprehensive Support and Services
MTS provides extensive support services, including system installation, training, consulting, and maintenance, to enhance productivity and efficiency in deploying test programs.
Accessories and Controllers
The document details various accessories and controllers available for MTS Acumen systems, such as pneumatic grips and the Bionix® EnviroBath, to support diverse testing needs.
Specifications
The document provides detailed specifications for MTS Acumen models, including dynamic and static force capacities, actuator stroke, test space dimensions, and electrical requirements, noting that specifications are subject to change.
Contact Information
Contact details for MTS regional offices in the Americas, Europe, and Asia/Pacific are provided for further inquiries.
